description: Returns social drops (videos, covers, copy) for the team, optionally filtered by status. Use when the user asks about drops, social assets, or ready-to-download content.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Defaults to 1.

per_page.description: Results per page, 1 to 100. Defaults to 10.

sort_by.description: Field to sort by: "updatedAt" (last edited), "createdAt" or "status".

sort_order.description: Sort direction: "ascend" (A to Z, lowest or oldest first) or "descend" (reverse).

status.description: Only show posts in this state: "draft", "processing" (being made), "ready" (can be exported) or "failed".

team_id.description: Team to act on. Omit to use the signed-in team.

name: list_team_drops
title: List team drops
